title: Transforming Ideas into Action with Copilot Chat (Part 1)

sections.title: Welcome and Session Context
sections.instructions: Welcome attendees, set expectations for session length, and explain live transcription/caption options in Teams.
sections.transcript:
Hello, hello, good day, good afternoon, good morning, good evening, wherever you are. Hello, hello. Welcome at this training about transforming ideas into action with CoPilot Chat.

I'm really happy that you are here. I'm really happy that you want to take some time away from your busy calendar and stay with me for one hour, one hour and a half. That's what we need to dive into this CoPilot Chat session.

I see a lot of people here. Thank you very much for joining. Thank you very much for taking the time.

You see that we are in a normal Teams meeting, so that means that I have put on transcriptions. You can change the language. You can show live captions.

What you see on my slide are the steps that you can follow if you want to change your language. You can also continue and set the translation, select the language to your preferred language, if you will. Please do so.

sections.transcript:

sections.transcript:

Today, we are going to see three different modules. The first module will be about M365 Copilot Chat. I know maybe some of you have a confusion around what is now the interface that we need to use.

What is included in our environment? What have you if you have an individual or a personal account? I will quickly touch on the differences. sections.title: What M365 Copilot Chat Is
sections.instructions: Introduce Copilot Chat as an AI assistant and reinforce that quality output depends on specific, explicit prompting.
sections.transcript:
What is it? First of all, if we talk about M365 Copilot Chat, it is our AI assistant. What is an AI assistant? Well, it's in the word. It's still an assistant.

You need to instruct Copilot to do exactly what you want. Ask very specifically what you want to get out of Copilot and what you want to as a result. That's very important.
